run_state.description: Mark run stalled if no new metrics received for more than 3x median step time.

gradients.description: Watch if more than 30% of steps in rolling window exceed the gradient clipping threshold.

throughput.description: Alert if peak VRAM exceeds 7.5 GB on an 8 GB device, or throughput drops below floor.

moe_drops.description: Under 2.0% is OK, 2.0% - 5.0% is WATCH, over 5.0% is ALERT.

moe_balance.description: Uniform expert share is 6.25% across 16 routed experts. Watch if any expert exceeds 15.0%, Alert if exceeds 25.0%.

recurrent_loops.description: Watch if Pulse 2 -> Pulse 3 gain (ce2 - ce3) drops below 0.01 for 3 consecutive evaluations after step 3,000.

numerics.description: Alert immediately on any NaN or Inf loss or gradient norm.
